label: Tête de Moine
note: Eaten as thin rosettes shaved with the girolle (invented 1982 by Nicolas Crevoisier); AOC 2001, AOP since 2010

about.text: Tête de Moine is a semi-hard Swiss cheese from raw cow milk, made in the Bernese Jura and Canton of Jura and pared into rosettes rather than cut.
